jobs.title: Sr. Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.

Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best & Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy - transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary - come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S.

As a remote-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title.

Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn!

The Sr Implementation Specialist serves as an experienced implementation professional responsible for leading complex software configuration, testing, and customer onboarding activities across Alkami Digital Banking implementations. This role independently manages implementation execution for diverse customer environments, including onboarding and live-client work, coordinates cross-functional delivery efforts, and guides customers through configuration, testing, cutover readiness, and launch activities to ensure successful implementation outcomes and positive customer experiences. The position applies advanced product knowledge, troubleshooting expertise, and project coordination skills to resolve implementation challenges, support operational readiness, and improve implementation quality and efficiency. The Sr Implementation Specialist operates independently on complex engagements, contributes to process improvements, and provides functional leadership within assigned product or implementation ownership areas.

**Essential Duties &** **Responsibilities**

* Lead complex software implementation activities by configuring and customizing Alkami products to support customer onboarding, testing, training, and launch readiness requirements across diverse implementation environments
* Independently manage customer implementation engagements by coordinating configuration tasks, ticket-driven workflows, project milestones, and stakeholder alignment across customers, vendors, and internal teams throughout project execution
* Guide customers through user acceptance testing and operational readiness activities by facilitating testing sessions, validating workflows, troubleshooting issues, and supporting implementation and cutover readiness requirements
* Perform advanced functional and integration testing by analyzing system behaviors, validating configurations, documenting results, and resolving implementation-related discrepancies prior to deployment
* Troubleshoot complex configuration, usability, and implementation issues by performing root-cause analysis, identifying corrective actions, and coordinating resolution efforts across technical, operational, and vendor stakeholders
* Collaborate with customers and third-party vendors by gathering configuration requirements, validating implementation details, and ensuring external dependencies are aligned with project timelines and delivery objectives
* Provide regular implementation updates to customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders by communicating project progress, issue resolution status, testing outcomes, and operational risks throughout implementation engagements
* Track and manage implementation activities by maintaining visibility into configuration progress, testing milestones, issue escalations, and project dependencies across multiple concurrent implementations
* Develop and maintain detailed implementation documentation by recording configuration settings, testing outcomes, issue logs, standard operating guidance, and customer and vendor communications throughout the implementation lifecycle
* Support implementation-related billing coordination by accurately documenting add-on sales activities, validating billable work, and ensuring implementation-related charges are properly tracked and communicated
* Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned Alkami products, integrations, or implementation functions by maintaining advanced knowledge, guiding delivery decisions, and supporting consistent execution across customer engagements
* Collaborate with Product, Support, Engineering, and Implementation teams by communicating customer feedback, implementation trends, and operational challenges that influence process improvements and product enhancements
* Manage multiple complex implementation priorities simultaneously by balancing customer needs, testing activities, issue resolution efforts, and project timelines across concurrent engagements
* Contribute to operational improvement initiatives by identifying implementation inefficiencies, recommending workflow enhancements, improving documentation and testing practices, and supporting best-practice development that improves implementation scalability and customer experience
* Support and mentor less experienced implementation specialists by providing guidance on testing methodologies, troubleshooting practices, customer and vendor communication strategies, and implementation procedures

**Recommended Experience & Education**

***Minimum Years of Experience***

3–6 years of experience leading software implementations, customer onboarding activities, configuration management, testing operations, or technical consulting engagements within SaaS, fintech, banking technology, or related environments.

***Education Level*** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Information Technology, Communications, or a related field.

**Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications**

**Required**

* Advanced experience supporting software implementations, configuration management, and customer onboarding activities
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills related to software configuration, testing, vendor coordination, and implementation issues across multiple customer environments
* Ability to independently manage complex implementation projects and competing priorities
* Experience facilitating user acceptance testing, functional validation, and operational readiness activities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with customer-facing and cross-functional stakeholder experience
* Experience collaborating with customers, vendors, and technical teams to coordinate implementation execution
* Ability to maintain detailed implementation documentation and operational tracking materials
* Strong organizational, analytical, and customer relationship management skills in fast-paced implementation environments

New Logo

* Ability to travel up to 20% to support implementation projects

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting fintech, SaaS, or digital banking implementation programs
* Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or technical onboarding concepts
* Experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar project management, testing, issue tracking, and documentation platforms
* Experience contributing to process optimization or implementation scalability initiatives
* Knowledge of software deployment, operational readiness, or change management practices
* Experience mentoring implementation specialists or supporting team knowledge-sharing activities

  
The salary range for this position is: $78,540 - $98,175

**Cool Things to Know**
=======================

**Not Just Any Company**: Alkami has an awesome diverse and inclusive environment. We have a FUN culture and offer great benefits, including remote-first environment, unlimited paid time off, 401(k) with employer match, and more.

**Work Authorization**: We cannot offer employment sponsorship at this time. Candidates must be eligible to work in the US for full-time employment.

**Recruiters**: We are not looking for outside recruiting firms to help us in this search. Thank you for understanding.

**Pay Transparency:** As of January 1, 2023, new states and locales have enacted pay equity laws that require more pay transparency by employers in the following states: California, Colorado (effective January 1, 2021), Connecticut, Maryland, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Rhode Island and Washington.

**The Important Stuff**
=======================

**Alkami Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind:** Alkami is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Alkami are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Alkami will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Alkami encourages applicants of all ages.

jobs.title: SVP - Implementation - Corporate Travel Management
jobs.description:
**Summary**
===========

Direct Travel is seeking a strategic, results-driven executive to serve as Senior Vice President of Implementation. This leader owns the full customer activation lifecycle across our global footprint and is accountable for delivering fast, high-quality, repeatable onboarding that speeds up time to revenue and sets clients up for long-term success.

The SVP leads two organizations, Implementation and Global Solution Design. They set the vision, operating model, and performance standards for how Direct Travel scopes, sells, and delivers global travel programs. As a member of the extended leadership team, the SVP works with Sales, Operations, Technology, Product, Finance, and Legal to turn commercial wins into operational success, and drives company-wide initiatives that align systems, processes, and people for growth at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Strategic Leadership & Organizational Ownership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Set and carry out the multi-year strategy for implementation and global solution design, in line with company growth, retention, and profitability goals.
* Own the organization's budget, headcount plan, and resource model. Scale capacity ahead of pipeline and sales forecasts.
* Design the organization, roles, and career paths needed to support a growing, increasingly global client base.
* Represent Implementation at the executive level: report on performance, risks, and investment needs to the Chief Customer Success Officer and leadership team.

**Implementation Delivery & Operational Excellence**
----------------------------------------------------

* Hold executive accountability for every client implementation, from contract signature through go-live, phase-ins, acquisitions, and global expansions.
* Build and continuously improve a scalable, standardized implementation methodology and playbook, with clear stage gates, governance, and quality controls.
* Use automation, tooling, and data to cut cycle times, lower cost-to-implement, and improve predictability.
* Set up portfolio-level governance that gives the organization visibility into delivery health, at-risk accounts, and backlog.
* Serve as the final escalation point for high-risk or strategic implementations. Resolve issues quickly and protect client relationships and revenue.

**Global Solution Design & Commercial Partnership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead the Global Solution Design function, making sure multinational client solutions are commercially sound, operationally deliverable, and matched to local and regional service capabilities.
* Partner with Sales leadership on strategic pursuits and RFPs. Provide executive-level solutioning, implementation strategy, and client-facing presence in final-stage presentations.
* Make sure every solution sold can be delivered. Hold scoping, pricing assumptions, and contract commitments to standard, and flag delivery risk early in the sales cycle.
* Work with Product and Technology to shape the service and platform roadmap based on client requirements and market trends.

**Client Executive Engagement**
-------------------------------

* Build trusted relationships with client executives (travel, procurement, finance, and HR leaders), acting as a strategic advisor through onboarding and into steady state.
* Deliver a smooth transition to Account Management and Operations, with clear success criteria and post-implementation reviews.
* Use client feedback and implementation data to raise satisfaction and support long-term retention and growth.

**People Leadership**
---------------------

* Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing global team of implementation directors, project managers, solution designers, and technical specialists.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and client focus.
* Set clear goals and performance expectations. Develop the next generation of leaders and plan for succession.

**Key Performance Outcomes**
----------------------------

* Faster time to revenue by shortening implementation cycle times.
* New air booking transaction targets met through strong onboarding and service adoption.
* Implementations delivered on time, on scope, and within budget.
* High client satisfaction and adoption at go-live, and fewer revenue-at-risk accounts.
* Better implementation margin and efficiency as the business scales.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in travel management, professional services, implementation, or customer success, including at least 5 years at the senior executive level leading multi-team, global organizations.
* A proven record of building and scaling implementation functions, including methodology, tooling, metrics, and org design, in a high-growth or transforming business.
* Deep expertise in global service delivery and solution design for complex multinational clients.
* Strong commercial sense and experience working with Sales on strategic deals and complex RFPs.
* In-depth knowledge of corporate travel ecosystems and technology platforms (such as Sabre, Amadeus, and Spotnana), as well as online booking tools and industry best practices.
* Experience managing budgets, headcount, and operating KPIs, and making data-driven decisions.
* Executive presence and strong communication skills, with the ability to influence the C-suite both internally and at clients.
* A track record of leading distributed, virtual, and global teams.
* A bachelor's degree is highly preferred; an MBA or PMP is a plus.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what's going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We're a technology-led service with a human touch.

### **About the Role**

The Training Specialist supports the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of enablement programs for Customer Success — primarily onboarding and skills training for Marketing Assistants and Account Managers. Working within established frameworks and with guidance from senior team members, delivers training on the Scorpion technology suite (Platform, CSX, CMS, My Site, Enterprise Portal), client communication and service standards, and core digital marketing concepts to help client-facing teams ramp quickly and consistently.

### **What Your Success Will Look Like**

* Deliver established onboarding and skills-training programs for customer-facing roles (client communication, service standards, tools, turnaround expectations).
* Facilitate sessions in person and virtually, applying proven techniques with coaching from senior team members.
* Build and maintain training content and job aids on the Scorpion tech suite (Platform, CSX, CMS, My Site, Enterprise Portal) and digital-marketing channels (SEO, paid, social, content).
* Administer learning paths in the LMS / enablement platform (scheduling, enrollment, completion tracking).
* Gather and summarize feedback, assessment results, quality scores, and completion data to support refinement.
* Contribute to the enablement content library and suggest improvements to existing materials.
* Partner with AMs, Directors, leadership, and support teams to keep content current with evolving tools and client processes.
* Build foundational knowledge of account management and customer success best practices.

### **Who You Are And What You Bring**

* Education
  + Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Education, or related field —or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience
  + 2+ years of experience in Enablement, Training, Account Management, Customer Success, or Learning & Development — preferably in digital marketing / SaaS; or advanced degree; or equivalent.
  + Working proficiency with LMS, Zoom, Google Workspace, MS Office 365; familiarity with CRM / CS tooling a plus.
  + Familiarity with digital-marketing channels (SEO, paid, social, content) and client-service workflows.

* Skills
  + Solid facilitation and presentation skills.
  + Strong written/verbal communication and organizational skills; collaborative and proactive.

### **Our Scorpion Values**

* **Winning Mindset:** When our clients win, we win.
* **Genuine Care:** We only succeed when we are truly invested in our clients and each other.
* **Unmatched Results:** We deliver more than expected–and then some–driving the best results and impacting lives.
* **Constant Improvement:** We believe there is always a better way. We learn we ask "What if?" we build and then do it again.
* **Unbeatable Teamwork:** We come from different backgrounds but have the same vision. We only get there by doing it together, as a team.

### **Compensation**

We acknowledge that states have passed legislation promoting pay transparency. As a national employer, Scorpion has made the decision to post our expected pay rate or pay range (as applicable) in all our job postings, regardless of geographic location.

* The base salary range is $70,000 (entry-level) - $80,000 (highly experienced), exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth.
* The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary bonuses or commissions.

### **Our Benefits**

We invest in our employees by offering them diverse benefits from best-in-class carriers. These benefits provide enough choice and flexibility to keep our employees and their families healthy and happy—today and tomorrow.

* 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible paid time off, so you can rest, relax, and recharge away from work
* Paid parental leave
* Paid cell phone and service
* Remote office allowance
* Professional development and development courses
* Regular manager check-ins to drive performance and career growth through Lattice

### **Work Location & Flexibility**

Scorpion supports a range of work arrangements, including in-office, hybrid, and remote roles. For positions designated as remote, employees who live within commuting distance of a Scorpion office may be asked to work from the office based on team needs, collaboration opportunities, or business priorities. Specific expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Scorpion is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or physical or mental disability. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion.

[Reasonable Accommodations]

**Applicant Privacy**

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to Scorpion. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

**E-Verify**

Scorpion participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment authorization of all newly hired employees. The E-Verify process is completed during new hire onboarding and completion of the Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification, at the start of employment. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates. For more information on E-Verify, please visit www.uscis.gov.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

**About the role**

Rippling’s Professional Services team is responsible for ensuring customers see incredible business transformations by maximizing the value of our core Platform- including custom workflows, advanced reports/analytics, permission profiles, and approvals. Professional Services engagements are consultative and customized based on the customers’ unique needs/pain points.

The ideal candidate is a customer advocate, product advocate, and natural problem solver. *This role specifically, is technical. A candidate who is strong in Excel/ SQL and is curious about technology and platforms will succeed.*

* + Design and document new use cases for our platform.
  + Train our internal and external teams through webinars

* Actively contribute to the development of new Platform features
* + Coordinate with product and engineering teams to support new use cases.
  + Assist with user testing and beta programs for new features.

### **What you will need**

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in professional services, implementation, or customer success
* + An ability to build relationships with customers
  + An ability to manage a book of business and control the customer’s implementation experience
  + A curiosity for product/technology
* *Strong preference*

* Ruthless prioritization and time management
* Strong attention to detail and ability to solve complex, interdependent problems

* Flexible to scaling and changing organizations and responsibilities
* Experience working with product and engineering teams to build and launch new products or features

jobs.title: Digital Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Lumistry**

Lumistry serves over 9,000 pharmacies globally, helping them transform their businesses to improve adherence, reduce operating costs and increase revenue. We offer a collection of solutions purpose-built for pharmacies, enabling our customers to engage with their patients, consolidate vendors, improve patient health literacy, automate tasks and initiate online scheduling for programs and services. For more information, visit lumistry.com.

### **The Opportunity**

As a Digital Implementation Specialist, you'll build, review, test, and launch the websites and digital products our pharmacy customers rely on. Your job is to make sure every site is accurate, functional, polished, and ready for launch. You'll also keep Digital operations running day to day, from setting up domain-based email to handling product teardowns. You'll do well if you love details, take ownership, and keep work moving without lowering the bar. You'll find and fix issues, improve our processes, and look for ways to make Lumistry's Digital products easier to use and better for customers. Our goal is for every Digital product and service to be delivered accurately, consistently, and at the quality our customers expect.

### **What You'll Own**

**Website Delivery and Support**

* Build and deploy customer websites in Replit, following Lumistry standards, build processes, and customer requirements.
* Review completed builds for visual accuracy, layout consistency, and content quality, and make adjustments as needed.
* Migrate content, imagery, services, and functionality from customers' existing websites, and resolve anything missing or inconsistent before launch.
* Test functionality and responsiveness on desktop and mobile, including navigation, links, forms, integrations, and other interactive elements.
* Hold every site to our QA standards while finding ways to improve design, usability, accessibility, and the visitor experience.
* Support enterprise and non-enterprise projects, including large-scale website migrations and other Digital initiatives.
* Help create, test, and improve website templates, standards, and build resources.
* Meet production goals, timelines, quality expectations, and SLAs.

**Digital Operations and Cross-Functional Support**

* Create and configure domain-based Google email inboxes for customers during onboarding and ongoing support.
* Monitor and complete Digital teardown requests so websites and their associated services are properly disconnected or removed.
* Identify and escalate blockers, dependencies, or issues that could affect customer timelines or service delivery.
* Monitor your assigned Salesforce queues so requests keep moving and SLAs are met.
* Maintain internal documentation and support cross-functional onboarding and training on Digital products and processes.
* Take part in audits, migrations, and special projects as assigned by Digital leadership.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **What You Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Experience creating, editing, or maintaining websites
* Experience using AI-powered tools, and real comfort adopting new technology
* Strong attention to detail, with an eye for visual, content, and functional inconsistencies
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, queues, and priorities at once
* Ability to troubleshoot problems and learn new technical tools and processes on your own
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, evolving environment
* A track record of meeting deadlines and production and service-level expectations
* Ability to collaborate across technical and customer-facing teams

**Preferred**

* Experience with Replit and Salesforce
* Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards, responsive web design, and SEO best practices
* Experience in a queue-based or production-oriented environment

### **Compensation**

The approximate range for this role is $58,000 to $62,000, depending on experience and skills.

### **Benefits**

Lumistry offers a comprehensive benefits package, including flexible time off; medical, dental, and vision coverage; long-term disability coverage; fitness benefits; and more.

### **Diversity and Inclusion at Lumistry**

Lumistry is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to an inclusive workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This commitment applies to every part of employment, from recruiting and hiring to compensation and promotion. We base our decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and current business needs.

### **Accessibility**

We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process. If you need assistance, please reach out.

jobs.title: Health System Specialist- (Electronic Health Record Modernization EHRM)
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

Serves as an EHRM (Electronic Health Record Modernization) Deployment Health System Specialist within VA Eastern Kansas HCS. Provides administrative leadership and direction pertaining to EHRM implementation, ensuring operational efficiency and effectiveness during the deployment of Cerner in collaboration with Midwest Consortium and the Office of Health Technology (OHT).

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

ALL US CITIZENS DIRECT HIRE AUTHORITY: This position is being filled using Direct-Hire Authority (5 CFR 337.201) for this occupation.

  

**Duties**
----------

**EHRM Advisor, Coach, Mentor (25%)**
  
Provides advisory services to all levels of medical center management regarding the requirements and implications of the EHRM deployment. Provides advice to operating managers and supervisors on deployment requirements (derived from general systems theory, the theory of constraints, queuing theory, Lean thinking, Six Sigma, etc.) that can assist in accomplishing the departmental missions and programmatic objectives of the medical center.
  
  
Contributes to the professional growth and development of effective teams/team members and ensures that staff are trained in EHRM principles and expectations. Provides oversight and ensures coordination of collaborative and training opportunities, including VISN-led requirements, medical center teleconferences, and other national and VISN learning opportunities as the deployment progresses. Identifies the appropriate target audiences for each
  
training opportunity and encourages participation of designated medical center staff.
  
  
**Program/Project Analysis and Evaluation (25%)**
  
Investigates and analyzes potential or realized adverse clinical operations, trends or conditions and initiates/recommends corrective action and follow-through as a result of electronic health record conversion and effects on direct patient care. Coordinates with medical center leaders to develop effective project/program plans to resolve serious clinical operations situations. Provides in-depth analyses, best practice models, and creative quality program techniques for consideration in project development. Develops innovative strategies and recommendations for initiating and establishing goals,
  
timetables, and procedures to ensure successful completion of EHRM deadlines. Assesses and analyzes medical center adoption of solutions and implements change management strategies and plans that maximize adoption.
  
  
**Coalition Building and Customer Service (10%)**
  
Maintains active communication with all medical center staff, affiliated partners, and other relevant personnel regarding the function and operation of the medical center EHRM. Serves as a liaison to various V15 departments and programs covering information transmission, meeting and project coordination, and clinical support and administrative issues related to the EHRM deployment.
  
  
**Work Schedule:** Monday thru Friday - hours to be set by supervisor
  
**Position Description Title/PD#:** Health System Specialist- (Electronic Health Record Modernization EHRM)/PD100320
  
  
**Physical Requirements**: Physical aspects associated with work required of this assignment are typical for the occupation and would generally not require a pre-placement examination.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* You must be a U.S. citizen to apply for this job
* Subject to a background/suitability investigation
* Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959
* A complete application package; Resume, Transcripts, etc. is required
* Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/form-i-9-acceptable-documents).
* Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment.

  
As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1-year probationary period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider:

* your performance and conduct;
* the needs and interests of the agency;
* whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and
* whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service

Upon completion of your probationary period or trial period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

### **Qualifications**

**To qualify for this position,** applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

### **Individual Occupational Requirements**

### **Undergraduate and Graduate Education:**

Major study - hospital administration, public health administration, or related fields such as business or public administration with course work in health care administration.

OR

### **Specialized Experience**

Progressively responsible analytical or administrative, or clinical management or supervisory experience in the health care field. This work may have been performed in an operating health care facility or a higher organizational echelon with advisory or directional authority over such facilities. Work must have involved a close working relationship with facility managers and analysis and/or coordination of administrative, clinical, or other service activities, and provided knowledge of the following:

* Missions, organizations, programs, and requirements of health care delivery systems;
* Regulations and standards of various regulatory and credentialing groups; and
* Government-wide, agency, and facility systems and requirements in various administrative areas such as budget, personnel, and procurement.

### **Special Provision for Inservice Placement:**

Successful completion of an agency-sponsored on-the-job training program may be substituted for qualifying experience, provided it included a formal individualized training plan. Such a training program must have been conducted in an operating health care system and included:

* Assignments providing a knowledge of basic health system administration philosophies, practices, and procedures, and basic government administrative policies and requirements;
* Practical assignments providing an opportunity to apply health system administration skills and principles (as the individual progresses, work assignments must be characteristic of the grade level to which he or she is assigned); and
* Oversight by an experienced health system administrator with periodic evaluation of the individual's progress and appropriate adjustment of the training program.

**AND:**

One year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-12 grade level in the federal service); experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills and abilities (KSA's) and other characteristics to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled, in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

**Preferred Experience**: Knowledge and experience with large scale electronic health records implementation for Healthcare Organizations.

It is a requirement that all HCP to receive annual seasonal influenza vaccination or obtain an exemption for medical or religious reasons. Wearing a face mask is required when an exemption to the influenza vaccination has been granted. HCP in violation of this directive may face disciplinary action up to and including removal from federal service. HCP are individuals who, during the influenza season, work in VHA locations or who come into contact with VA patients or other HCP as part of their duties. VHA locations include, but are not limited to, VA hospitals and associated clinics, community living centers (CLCs), community-based outpatient clinics (CBOCs), domiciliary units, Vet centers and VA-leased medical facilities. jobs.title: Product Implementation Lead – US Remote, Eastern or Central Time Zone
jobs.description:
**Location: Remote, US – Eastern or Central Time Zone**

**Reports to: Chief Product Officer**

**Required availability: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday**

**Type: Full-time**

**About ColigoMed**

ColigoMed is a US healthcare AI company automating the administrative work that slows down specialty care. Our agentic AI platform delivers touchless eligibility and benefits verification, autonomous prior authorization with EMR write-back, integrated care program enablement (RPM, CCM, PCM, TCM), and hospital readmission reduction, supported by a patient app and a provider app. We are live with 50+ paying customers across cardiology, pulmonology, and pain management and backed by an $8M seed round from 70+ physicians.

**The role**

You will be the person customers rely on to get issues resolved and the link between customers, Product, and Engineering. Reporting directly to the CPO, you will own customer inquiries and issues across our platform and patient and provider apps, keep customers informed through resolution, support customer onboarding, and translate customer workflows and needs into clear product requirements.

Resolving customer issues and communicating directly with customers will be a significant part of the role. You will assess the impact and urgency of issues, coordinate with the appropriate teams, and remain accountable for progress through resolution.

You will start each day working with our India, Vietnam, and Romania-based Engineering teams on priority issues, support our Central and East Coast customers through the business day, and close with a concise check-in with the CPO.

**What you’ll do**

* **Own customer inquiries and issues**. Act as the primary point of contact for product questions, issues, and escalations from practices and health systems, and see every one through to resolution. Understand the customer’s concern, gather the relevant information, assess its impact and urgency, involve Product, Engineering or other teams when needed, and remain accountable for keeping the issue moving and the customer informed.
* **Track every issue and communicate proactively**. Maintain a clear, current record of every open issue with its owner, status, customer impact, and next step. Update customers before they have to ask: when an issue is logged, when further investigation is required, when a fix or next step is scheduled, and when it is resolved. No customer should ever have to chase us for a status update.
* **Be the eligibility and benefits expert.** Explain eligibility and benefits results to practice staff with confidence: coverage status, plan type, deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, network status, coordination of benefits, and whether a service requires prior authorization. When a result looks wrong, assess where the issue may be occurring and work with the appropriate internal or external team where further investigation is required.
* **Support the provider and patient apps.** Resolve customer-facing issues across the provider app used by clinicians and care teams and the patient app used by enrolled patients, including login and access, device data syncing, care plan and check-in workflows, notifications, and data that doesn’t match between the apps and the EMR. Gather and document the relevant information when Product or Engineering investigation is required.
* **Coordinate resolution of complex issues.** When a prior authorization doesn’t submit, a status doesn’t update, an EMR write-back fails, or patient data doesn’t reach the care team, gather the relevant customer, workflow and system information and work with Product, Engineering, payers, clearinghouses or other partners as appropriate to understand and resolve the issue.
* **Partner with Engineering.** Use the early-morning overlap to clearly document customer issues, provide the customer and workflow context needed for investigation, help assess customer and business impact and urgency, work with Engineering through resolution, and confirm fixes with customers.
* **Translate customer processes into product requirements**. Map each customer’s front-office, prior auth, eligibility, and care program workflows in detail, capture their specific requirements, and turn them into clear, testable product requirements and Jira tickets that Engineering can build from. Distinguish what is truly customer-specific configuration from what should become a product capability for all customers.
* **Identify product gaps**. Recognize patterns across customer issues, payer behavior, app usage, and workflows, and bring them to the CPO with supporting evidence and a recommended priority based on customer and operational impact.
* **Support customer onboarding.** Own assigned onboarding tasks for new customers, including configuration, EMR and payer workflow validation, app setup, and user training support. Validate that workflows work before go-live and catch early issues before customers do.
* **Report daily to the CPO.** Lead a concise end-of-day check-in with the CPO covering open issues, customer escalations, onboarding progress, product gaps, and priorities for the next morning’s Engineering overlap.
* **Build the playbook**. Maintain payer-specific troubleshooting guides, app support guides, known-issue documentation, and customer-facing help content.
* **Track payer and policy changes**. Flag changes to payer rules, prior auth requirements, benefit manager policies, and CMS guidance that affect how the product behaves.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 5+ years in healthcare RCM, practice operations, implementation, or product support, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing technical role at a health tech company.
* **Expert command of US eligibility and benefits verification.** You can walk a front-desk team or practice administrator through a benefits result in plain language across commercial plans, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and managed Medicaid.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of prior authorization: submission requirements, clinical documentation, status tracking, and peer-to-peer and appeals processes.
* Working command of the full revenue cycle: eligibility, charge capture, coding (CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS), claims, remittance, denials, and appeals.
* Hands-on working knowledge of at least two of these EMRs: athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Oracle Health (Cerner), and Epic.
* Hands-on experience with clearinghouses and multi-payer portals such as Availity, Waystar, and TriZetto.
* Hands-on experience with prior authorization and benefit management platforms such as Cohere Health, Evolent, and EviCore, and with payer portals including UnitedHealthcare, Humana, and Oscar.
* Experience supporting web or mobile applications, including troubleshooting user access, data sync, and device or integration issues.
* Experience investigating issues across systems, gathering the information required for resolution, and explaining issues clearly to engineers, practice staff, and patients.
* **Proven ability to translate customer processes into product requirements.** You can sit with a practice, understand exactly how their workflow runs, and write requirements that Engineering can build from without guessing.
* Strong judgment and prioritization skills. You can assess competing customer issues, understand their customer and business impact, determine urgency, and decide when and where escalation is required.
* **Ability to learn and adapt fast.** You get up to speed quickly on new payers, EMRs, workflows, and product areas, and you are comfortable with priorities that change as a fast-growing company evolves.
* Proficiency with Jira. You write tickets Engineering can act on without follow-up questions.
* Disciplined issue tracking and proactive customer communication. You keep every issue visible and current, and customers hear from you before they need to ask.
* Experience supporting customer onboarding or implementation projects.
* An acute sense of ownership. You remain accountable for customer communication and progress through resolution, even when another team owns the specialist technical investigation or fix.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including direct communication with US healthcare customers and asynchronous work with international teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with all four EMRs listed above.
* Familiarity with X12 transactions (270/271, 278, 837, 835), HL7, or FHIR.
* SQL or comfort querying data to support investigations.
* Experience in cardiology, pulmonology, or pain management practices.
* Exposure to RPM, CCM, or other CMS care management programs, including patient-facing remote monitoring apps and connected devices.
* Understanding of HIPAA requirements for patient-facing support.

**Working hours**

This is a full-time position requiring regular availability from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday.

The early start provides overlap with our Engineering teams in India, Vietnam and Romania so priority customer and product issues can be progressed before US customers begin their business day, followed by direct support for our East Coast customers through the business day.

The role requires availability throughout this coverage window, with reasonable flexibility to manage meal and personal breaks around customer and business requirements. Each day closes with a concise check-in with the CPO.

**What success looks like in 90 days**

* You are the go-to owner for customer inquiries and issues across the platform and both apps, with a defined issue-management and escalation process in place.
* You are effectively coordinating customer issues with Product, Engineering and other teams and ensuring they continue to progress through resolution.
* Issues identified during the early Engineering overlap are progressed with the appropriate teams before customers encounter them wherever possible.
* Every open issue is tracked with an owner, status, and next step, and customers receive proactive updates without having to follow up.
* You are independently running assigned onboarding tasks for new customers.
* The daily CPO check-in is a reliable, concise summary of issues, escalations, onboarding, and priorities.
* You have built payer-specific troubleshooting guides for our highest-volume payers and a support guide for the patient and provider apps.
* You have translated customer workflows into product requirements that Engineering has built from, with minimal clarification needed.
* You have brought forward a set of product gaps as clear, prioritized Jira tickets backed by customer evidence.

You are working independently across our main payers, EMRs, customer workflows and both apps, while effectively coordinating with Product and Engineering when specialist technical input is required.

**Why join**

* Work on a problem that directly affects whether patients get timely care.
* Report directly to the CPO and shape the product roadmap from day one.
* Work alongside physician investors and a founding team with multiple exits.

**Compensation:**  The position in salary range will take into account an assessment based on factors including the candidate's level of experience, education, skills, and location. A fully discretionary annual bonus of up to 10% of base salary and a stock option plan also applies. Eligibility for benefits commences after completing a two month introductory period.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $95,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you able to work remotely Monday through Friday and remain available from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time? Answer Yes or No

Experience:

* healthcare RCM, practice ops, implementation or support: 5 years (Required)
* US healthcare eligibility/benefits & prior authorization: 2 years (Required)
* working with 2+ EMR's - athena, eCW, Cerner or Epic: 2 years (Required)
* a Customer-facing technical role in health technology: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: System Implementation Project Lead
jobs.description:
**Introduction**

Retina Consultants of America is identifying and evaluating candidates for the position of **System Implementation Project Lead**. This position will report to the Director of System Operations. The System Implementation Project Lead role is a highly visible and challenging role that will help execute the vision of the company’s long-term and short-term strategy and become an integral member of a dynamic and experienced operational team.

**Our Company**

Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is bringing together national leaders in surgical and clinical care. This network comprises preeminent retina research specialists with the common goal of eradicating blindness caused by macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, and other retina diseases.

With over 2.3M annual patient visits, more than 315 physicians, and more than 295 locations, Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is the largest retina care provider in the nation.

**Our Mission**

Through RCA’s physician-centered practice management model, physicians continue to drive clinical care and practice culture, while benefiting from the business expertise, resources and sharing best practices.

RCA seeks to expand our mission by partnering with leading retina specialists who are passionate about delivering excellent patient care and participating in innovative research.

RCA has created a business model that enables retina specialists to retain autonomy and ownership, augmented by sharing best practices facilitated through the Medical Leadership Board and executive management support. Practices within the network will continue to drive all clinical decisions and remain highly involved in strategic operations.

**Our Core Values**

· Relentlessly Commit to our Patients, to the Practices We Serve and to Our Mission

· Embrace the Legacies of Our Partner Practices

· Strive for Continuous Improvement Through Education and Research

· Exude Compassion in All We Do

**Position Overview**

The System Implementation Project Lead is responsible for managing and overseeing implementations of new EHR/PM systems and ancillary products simultaneously across multiple practices within the platform. They will collaborate with key stakeholders, practice RCM and Clinical leaders, and other departments within the company to ensure that all key project milestones and timelines are achieved. The System Implementation Project Lead role requires comprehensive knowledge of physician revenue cycle management and clinical workflows to successfully lead implementations, align operational and clinical processes, and drive performance improvement. The ideal candidate demonstrates attention to detail, accountability, accuracy, sound business judgment, and the ability to balance organizational goals with the needs of providers, staff, and patients.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead implementation projects for clinical and operational systems, including EHR, Practice Management, patient engagement, and other healthcare technology platforms.
* Develop and manage project plans, timelines, resources, budgets, and deliverables.
* Monitor project progress, mitigate risks, and ensure successful on-time, in-scope project completion.
* Facilitate project meetings, status reporting, and executive communications.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with clinical, operational, revenue cycle, and IT teams to support system implementations and workflow optimization.
* Coordinate activities impacting scheduling, registration, documentation, billing, coding, collections, and reporting.
* Serve as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* Align implementation efforts with organizational, financial, and patient care objectives.

**Change Management & System Adoption**

* Oversee system testing, validation, go-live readiness, and post-implementation stabilization.
* Support training and change management initiatives to drive user adoption and operational success.
* Facilitate issue resolution and continuous process improvement.

**Vendor & Compliance Management**

* Manage vendor relationships, project deliverables, and implementation timelines.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, privacy, and security requirements.
* Track implementation metrics and measure outcomes against established goals.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Ability to direct and lead multiple projects concurrently.
* Knowledgeable in defining approach and resource requirements for projects.
* Strong organizational, customer service, interpersonal, facilitation, communication, and time management skills
* Outstanding poise in a fast-paced business environment
* Ability to work both independently and in a team setting.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (preference Project Management or Healthcare Administration) and/or 5 years of physician practice experience
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Project Management or Lead Position
* Experience in providing cross-functional support for a corporate team.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Proficient in Microsoft Outlook
* Proficient in Monday.com
* Experience and ability to navigate practice EHR PM systems and RCM/data reporting tools (Nextech, NextGen, Tableau, DOMO experience, a plus)

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Have you implemented Nextech Practice Plus - Practice Management System?

Work Location: Remote

**Overview:**

**Overview**
============

Sentara Health is now hiring an **IT Director, Clinical Systems**. This position will work remotely but must live within a drivable distance to Virginia Beach. The IT Director, Clinical Systems provides strategic, operational, and people leadership for the technology solutions supporting hospital-based clinical operations.

  

This role is accountable for the performance, optimization, governance, and future direction of the clinical systems portfolio supporting Pharmacy, Laboratory Services, Inpatient Physicians, Inpatient Nursing, Emergency Department, Research, Infection Prevention, Capacity Management, Throughput, and other hospital-based clinical service lines.

  

The Director serves as the primary IT executive partner for operational and clinical leaders, ensuring technology investments align with organizational priorities, improve patient outcomes, enhance caregiver experience, and support operational excellence.

**Education**
=============

* Bachelor's degree (Preferred)

or

* *At least 8 years of relevant management experience in lieu of bachelor's degree*

**Experience**
==============

* At least 5 years of relevant experience (Required)
* Hands on working experience with EPIC (Required)

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* **Strategic Leadership & Business Partnership**
  + Develop and execute the technology strategy and roadmap for hospital-based clinical systems.
  + Serve as the primary IT partner for executive, physician, nursing, pharmacy, laboratory, research, and operational leaders.
  + Align technology investments and priorities with organizational strategic goals, regulatory requirements, and clinical initiatives.
  + Drive adoption of innovative technologies, automation, analytics, and workflow improvements that improve patient care and operational performance.
* **Clinical Portfolio Oversight**
  + Provide executive oversight for the clinical systems portfolio supporting:
    - Pharmacy
    - Laboratory Services
    - Inpatient Physicians
    - Inpatient Nursing
    - Emergency Department
    - Research
    - Infection Prevention
    - Capacity Management and Throughput
    - Clinical Logistics
    - Additional hospital-based clinical departments and services
  + Ensure systems are reliable, optimized, integrated, and aligned with business and clinical objectives.
  + Establish portfolio roadmaps, modernization plans, and lifecycle management strategies.
* **Operations, Optimization & Service Delivery**
  + Lead ongoing optimization of clinical workflows and supporting technologies.
  + Ensure effective support, maintenance, monitoring, and performance management of clinical applications.
  + Drive improvements in operational metrics such as patient throughput, clinician efficiency, patient safety, quality outcomes, and user satisfaction.
  + Oversee production support, issue resolution, and major incident management activities.
* **Governance, Prioritization & Change Management**
  + Lead governance processes for intake, prioritization, demand management, and resource allocation.
  + Establish and maintain change control processes that balance operational stability with business agility.
  + Facilitate cross-functional decision-making regarding competing priorities and resource constraints.
  + Serve as the escalation point for highly complex clinical, operational, and technology issues.
* **Program & Project Execution**
  + Oversee major clinical systems initiatives, implementations, upgrades, integrations, and optimization efforts.
  + Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and achieve intended business outcomes.
  + Coordinate activities across business, clinical, operational, and technical teams.
  + Manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations across the portfolio.
* **Financial & Vendor Management**
  + Develop and manage operating and capital budgets for the clinical systems portfolio.
  + Ensure effective stewardship of financial resources and technology investments.
  + Lead vendor relationships, contract negotiations, service reviews, and performance management.
  + Support business case development and strategic investment planning.
* **Regulatory Compliance, Security & Risk Management**
  + Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare regulations, organizational policies, and security requirements.
  + Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, privacy, and risk management teams to protect clinical and patient data.
  + Maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, system resiliency, and access governance processes.
  + Identify and mitigate operational, regulatory, and technology risks.
* **Leadership & Talent Development**
  + Lead, coach, and develop a team of managers, analysts, and technical professionals.
  + Establish clear goals, accountability measures, and performance expectations.
  + Build leadership bench strength and succession plans.
  + Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* **Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management**
  + Present portfolio status, risks, investment needs, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
  + Build trusted relationships with physicians, nursing leadership, department directors, and operational partners.

Sentara is currently reviewing market compensation for this role. Our Talent Acquisition team will be able to share more specific information during the recruiting process.

**Benefits: Caring For Your Family and Your Career**

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Cloud Deployment team is the team that delivers cloud solutions to the public safety sector. Our team is committed to providing technology and tools which allow customers to focus on their mission to respond faster with smarter and safer decisions, to communicate effectively during emergencies by building easy to use, trustworthy critical communication and collaboration software.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Motorola Solutions is seeking an Implementation Specialist, a post-sales position within our software safety solutions team, delivering cloud solutions to the public safety sector. Growing rapidly with patented and award winning products, our software-as-a-service suite keeps millions of people across the United States safe, secure and connected. We are committed to providing technology and tools which will allow customers to focus on their mission and enable them to respond faster with smarter and safer decisions. We are seeking a self-motivated implementation professional with strong technical skills. You should be passionate about improving public safety, innovative technology, and deploying great software.

  
  

As an Implementation Specialist, you will collaborate across cross-functional teams to evaluate organizational readiness, streamline legacy workflows, and ensure enterprise business units are fully equipped to maximize cloud-native environments.

If you excel at translating complex technical shifts into smooth operational transitions, driving change, and measuring impact, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our global cloud delivery model.

  
  

Responsibilities:

The Implementation Specialist will play an integral role in the success of the Motorola Cloud Provisioning team by maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. The successful candidate should have a track record working directly with customers on the installation and configuration of SaaS solutions while answering technical questions and resolving complex customer issues. If you excel at translating complex technical shifts into smooth operational transitions, driving change, and measuring impact, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our global cloud deployment model.

Implementation Specialists ensure project success by overseeing the project lifecycle, execute the technical deployment, drive activation, configuration, and training to integrate new solutions. Role requires accountability, strong communication, client management, and problem-solving skills to meet deliverables, focusing on customer time to value.

Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Implementation Leadership & Delivery :

* Drive On-Time Activation and Delivery: Initiate, Plan, Execute, Monitor, Control and Solve
* Validate scope and goals, document and track deliverables and milestones to drive the implementation forward with clear expectations and target completion dates.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment across varied enterprise groups.
* Risk Management: Manage timeline and mitigate risks. Proactively anticipate issues, explore contingency plans, and provide effective escalation management throughout all phases.
* Leadership: Guide the client project team and ensure alignment with objectives.
* Respond to requests for assistance in a timely manner.
* Manage resolution of technical and non-technical issues.
* Troubleshoot a broad range of technical issues on the application and OS levels.
* Installation, migration and upgrade of products on accelerated time schedules.
* Develop a full understanding of all products.
* Create or contribute to process documentation and improvements.
* Write Standard Operating Procedures when required.
* Create and review knowledge base documentation and FAQs based on issue solutions.
* Conduct training on various Products and Services.
  

  

Qualifications :

* 4+ years operating at the intersection of business operations, project management, and cloud implementation in Enterprise, Public Safety or Government systems software implementation. Understanding of Public Safety customer environments for product security and reliability
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, MIS or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience) preferred
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as needed
* Excellent investigative and debugging skills
* Excellent problem solving skills, verbal and written communication skills, ability to work under strict deadlines and interact with customers of varying experience levels
* Demonstrated ability to research and resolve problems using a variety of tools
* Knowledge of one or more programming languages (Java, C++, Ruby)
* Knowledge of relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL)
* Knowledge of web services/web technology (HTML, CSS, XML, JSON)
* Knowledge of VMware, managing Virtual Machines
  

  

This position is subject to working in high security areas governed by the US Department of Justice's "Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy" and therefore requires successfully passing a more stringent fingerprint background check administered by Motorola Solutions Inc. customers.

  
  

Target Base Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000 USD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

  
  

#LI-RS1

#LI-Remote

  

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

High school diploma

4+ years operating at the intersection of business operations, project management, and cloud implementation in Enterprise, Public Safety or Government systems software implementation.

Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

Must be able to obtain a background clearance as required by our government customers.

  

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

Under 10%

**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None

**Position Type**
-----------------

Experienced

**Referral Payment Plan**
-------------------------

Yes

**Our U.S. Benefits include:**

* Incentive Bonus Plans
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits
* 401K with Company Match
* 10 Paid Holidays
* Generous Paid Time Off Packages
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Parental & Family Leave
* and more!

***EEO Statement***

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.
